==Description==
'''The Worm''' is an emote obtained from the [[Hexscape Event#Hexscape Event Battle Pass|Hexscape Event Battle Pass]]. It was made by Capra_K. This emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. Players can move while performing the emote but it cannot be interacted with.

This emote could be obtained at Level 25 of the regular track, where it costed {{CandyCorns|820 Candy Corns}} or {{Robux|80}} ({{Robux|60}} for the Black Friday 2024 Sale) to unlock. It had a total cost of {{CandyCorns|9,810 Candy Corns}} or {{Robux|1,900}} ({{Robux|1,429}} for the Black Friday 2024 Sale).

==Trivia==
*'''The Worm''' is based on an emote [[w:c:fortnite:The Worm|of the same name]] from ''Fortnite''.
*When using this emote while standing still, you slowly move to the right while rotating clockwise.
